# What is Shopify Payments really costing you?

> Free Shopify Payments fee analyzer: drop in your Transactions export CSV and see your real effective rate, fees by card brand and card source, refund and chargeback cost, and what-if rates. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
